mapper.sql: u.user_id, u.username, u.password, u.real_name, u.role, u.class_id, u.student_no, u.create_time, c.class_name
FROM sys_user u LEFT JOIN sys_class c ON u.class_id = c.class_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_user (username, password, real_name, role, class_id, student_no) VALUES (#{username}, #{password}, #{realName}, #{role}, #{classId}, #{studentNo})
mapper.update: UPDATE sys_user SET password = #{password} WHERE user_id = #{userId}
mapper.select: SELECT user_id, username, real_name, role FROM sys_user WHERE role = 'TEACHER' ORDER BY create_time DESC
